## Description

What broke, and what you expected instead.

## Steps

1. Harness version and plugin version.
2. What you clicked or which turn you opened.
3. What the reading view did.

## Context

Desktop or Web Host, browser, and whether auto-fold or glass was on. Paste the host error if the page says it failed to load plugins. Do not paste tokens.
